# Contributors

Beau Barker ([@bcb](https://github.com/bcb)) created jsonrpcclient, starting with [Initial import](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/commit/84e8697e6a247003f93c2de89c3be8f4890647a8) in 2014. Synapse Research has maintained it since 6 October 2026.

Everyone else on GitHub's contributor list for jsonrpcclient is below, by GitHub login. Bots are left out. Each link goes to the person's first change on main, or to the pull request it came in. The link text is that change's own title.

- Alex Waite ([@aqw](https://github.com/aqw)): [fix test when jsonrpcclient is not installed](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/169) (2021)
- Ben Abulafia ([@bensynapse](https://github.com/bensynapse)): [Rebuild CI and fix the broken tool configs](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/231) (2026)
- Grigory Vydrin ([@CrazyUmka](https://github.com/CrazyUmka)): [Fixed bug in async\_client.py](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/109) (2018)
- Eli W. Hunter ([@elihunter173](https://github.com/elihunter173)): [Make py.typed visible to mypy](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/143) (2020)
- E. M. Bray ([@embray](https://github.com/embray)): [Ensure py.typed file is included in source distribution](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/158) (2021)
- Xandre Ibuquil ([@fastfailures](https://github.com/fastfailures)): [Accept click version 7](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/147) (2020)
- JP ([@ferrouswheel](https://github.com/ferrouswheel)): [Add trim\_log\_values option to config to abbreviate long strings and lists](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/76) (2018)
- Frédéric Massart ([@FMCorz](https://github.com/FMCorz)): [Add a low-level socket client](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/105) (2018)
- Ryavkin Ivan ([@IvanRyavkin](https://github.com/IvanRyavkin)): [add timeout parameter in AiohttpClient](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/116) (2019)
- Skas Merkushin ([@LittleLampLight](https://github.com/LittleLampLight)): [Pass \*\*kwargs to AiohttpClient from client.send() call](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/145) (2020)
- OXullo Intersecans ([@oxullo](https://github.com/oxullo)): [Exposing access to aiohttp request() ssl parameter](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/94) (2018)
- Pedro Grojsgold ([@pgold](https://github.com/pgold)): [Allow for stray entries on a JSON-RPC response.](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/151) (2021)
- [@saaj](https://github.com/saaj): [Support asynchronous JSON RPC client with Tornado](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/17) (2016)
- Sebastian Brandt ([@sbrandtb](https://github.com/sbrandtb)): [Fix: Custom headers in Tornado Client](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/52) (2017)
- Will Tekulve ([@tekulvw](https://github.com/tekulvw)): [Ignore empty error bodies](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/57) (2017)
- Michael Morgan ([@villainy](https://github.com/villainy)): [Change build system interface to pyproject.toml](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/219) (2023)
- Yuuki ([@yuuki0xff](https://github.com/yuuki0xff)): [Fix unexpected behavior when passing one argument](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcclient/pull/118) (2019)

## How to contribute

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. [Contributing](contributing.md) explains how to set up, run the checks and send a pull request.
